longDescriptions.title: The Lamp District seven-layer civic cross-section
longDescriptions.summary: A vertical civic map of an inhabited district surviving through maintained misclassification. The layers are a political and operational order rather than a measure of literal depth alone.
entities: deep civic memory and inherited consequence
relations: The surface fiction protects the inhabitants while shifting risk onto people required to perform it.
Ordinary life depends on quiet maintenance, heat removal, drainage, transport, care, markets, and schools.
Authorized descent crosses jurisdictions and signature budgets rather than merely moving downward.
The Long Alarm changes what may be visible, who may decide, and which internal costs become compulsory.
A breach changes the public map and the next run; the district does not reset to hidden normality.
directions: Read from exterior classification toward deeper civic custody.
Cross-links show that wake can move upward through heat, traffic, testimony, missing people, and institutional records.
Return paths carry evidence and changed constituencies back toward ordinary public life.
runtimeEquivalents: Long Alarm, signature, visibility, and consequence values are available as text and exact engine state.
Layer names, objectives, authority, routes, wake sources, and inheritance are rendered in the Underworld representation.
The image is never the sole route into an expedition or the sole evidence of a changed district.

longDescriptions.title: The Relief Circuit multispecies vessel cross-section
longDescriptions.summary: A systems map of one moving polity whose inhabitants require incompatible media, gravity, scale, passage, sensorium, interfaces, and clocks.
relations: The transit body carries the ship but cannot be treated as a continuous human-normal hallway.
Habitat bands preserve incompatible environmental media and gravity regimes.
Common thresholds are negotiated interfaces where passage, contamination, pressure, translation, and authority become visible.
The translation mesh connects direct and mediated interfaces without making mediation equivalent to consent.
The watch lattice binds embodied people to operational roles through Arc-owned feasibility rather than body-based destiny.
The continuity commons preserves succession, fork, memory, and life-fraction obligations across handoffs.
The sovereign core records precedent and emergency authority without absorbing the ship's constituent peoples.
The scarway carries the connected Lamp District operation and its returning consequences.
directions: Read from the vessel's physical carrying body through habitat and interface systems toward constitutional continuity.
Operational flow crosses the section through watch composition, common-system allocation, pressure resolution, handoff, and return.
No arrow implies that one body, clock, or interface is the ship's natural baseline.
runtimeEquivalents: Every named system appears as localized text in the Common Ship representation.
Embodiment profiles and role profiles are separately inspectable.
All eight ship-state tracks, six Common Watch tests, dependencies, single points, and precedents are available without reading the SVG.

longDescriptions.title: The Relief Circuit operational symbol atlas
longDescriptions.summary: A source atlas containing six Common Watch tests, seven ship systems, and eight ship-state tracks. Symbols summarize records already carried by text and engine receipts.
relations: Watch-test symbols report Arc-owned feasibility and refusal categories.
System symbols identify where allocations and dependencies reside.
State symbols identify engine-owned values that change through operations.
A shared visual shape never converts a system, test, and state into the same semantic object.
directions: The atlas is grouped by test, system, and state rather than ordered as one process.
Runtime use must pair every symbol with its authored or localized label and current value.
runtimeEquivalents: The Common Ship scene exposes all twenty-one labels and their live records as HTML text.
Forced-colors mode may suppress decorative atlas presentation without removing operational meaning.
Imported Common Ships use the neutral symbol set when no cartridge-owned atlas exists.

longDescriptions.title: Ilyon campaign, faction, evidence, and consequence symbol system
longDescriptions.summary: A cartridge-owned motif system that distinguishes campaign pressure, faction position, evidence provenance, and inherited consequence in the Confluence Observatory's civic language.
relations: Campaign-pressure marks orient the causal sequence and do not replace the authored pressure names.
Faction marks identify actors and receipts without assigning one visual style the status of neutral truth.
Evidence marks supplement the evidence ledger's venue, legitimacy target, upside, downside, failure mode, intervention, and limits.
Consequence marks point toward inherited run state rather than announcing a clean ending.
directions: Read campaign marks in authored beat order.
Read evidence, faction, and consequence marks through their associated ledger text rather than as a universal pictographic language.
runtimeEquivalents: Aperture renders the complete Pocket, evidence ledger, faction receipts, and persistent consequences as text.
Neutral imported cartridges receive no Ilyon motif merely because their data resembles one of its concepts.
Missing motifs never prevent campaign play, run export, or source inspection.

assets.title: The First Charter founding hall
assets.description: A warm civic hall of timber, brass, teal wax seals, ledgers, and a moonlit charter window.

assets.title: First Charter Founding Hall foreground frame
assets.description: Layered dark timber beams, teal charter cloth, a pale founding emblem, and a low shadowed threshold frame the inhabited Founding Hall without carrying gameplay state or interaction.

assets.title: Maren Vos, Charter-Keeper
assets.description: An original painted-vector portrait of an older charter keeper holding the founding ledger.

assets.title: Aster Neral, astronomer of Ilyon
assets.description: An Ilyon astronomer in deep teal and nacre robes, holding a brass lens before an ocean observatory and the dead neighboring star.

assets.title: The Ilyon Confluence Observatory
assets.description: An oceanic civic observatory of nacre, brass, coral, tideglass, and open water, built for astronomy and public refusal.

assets.title: The Ilyon observatory framing
assets.description: Nacre arches, tideglass railings, brass instruments, and coral growth frame the public observatory while preserving the central council space.

assets.title: Seren Vale, Warden of the Lamplit Survey
assets.description: A tower survey warden in an amethyst hood and layered violet coat, holding a blue lantern compass before a moonlit gothic window.

assets.title: The Waking Tower survey hall
assets.description: A violet-night tower hall with blue survey lanterns, a moonlit orrery window, spiral galleries, chains, and a long raid table.

assets.title: The Waking Tower hall framing
assets.description: Dark tower arches, chainwork, balcony rails, and blue lantern glass frame the survey hall without obscuring its playable center.

assets.title: Anja Vei, Lamp District teacher and interlocutor
assets.description: A formal vector portrait of a Lamp District teacher carrying witness tablets beneath amber communal lamps.

assets.title: Lamp District seven-layer cross section
assets.description: Seven labelled functional strata descend from the grave-skin through the shroud, quiet works, common depths, custodial ring, war layer and black core.

assets.title: Lamp District civic underworld
assets.description: A layered buried district of communal lamps, cistern bridges, salt-vault radiators, homes, a school, clinic, market and sealed war machinery beneath a ruined survey outpost.

assets.title: Arden Pell, nine-year analyst
assets.description: A short-lived analyst surrounded by compressed calendars, overlapping decision horizons, and a life-fraction ledger that makes routine standby visibly expensive.

assets.title: Cinder Continuing, Counterborn vessel fork
assets.description: A machine person distributed through routing, translation, memory, and hull substrate, shown as several divergent bodies connected to one luminous but contested continuity claim.

assets.title: Ilya Venn, rapid-response pilot
assets.description: A dry-bodied pilot in a direct-interface flight harness, standing before the Relief Circuit helm with manual abort controls and several incompatible habitat clocks reflected in the canopy.

assets.title: Nima Quell, aquatic care worker
assets.description: A large aquatic citizen suspended in a pressure-continuity care chamber, communicating through pressure song, electroreceptive lights, and a translated dry-space display.

assets.title: Orun Sable, high-gravity maintainer
assets.description: A massive load-bearing maintainer in a reinforced pressure harness, braced against a structural contact wall where ordinary corridors become inaccessible work terrain.

assets.title: The Relief Circuit vessel cross-section
assets.description: A cutaway of the Common Ship showing its transit body, habitat bands, exchange thresholds, translation mesh, watch lattice, continuity commons, sovereign core, and route to the Lamp District.

assets.title: The Relief Circuit common threshold
assets.description: A multispecies ship interior where dry command, aquatic care, high-gravity maintenance, microbial mediation, short-life analysis, and machine continuity meet around one contested operating table.

assets.title: The Relief Circuit operational symbol atlas
assets.description: Twenty-one direct production symbols for the six Common Watch tests, seven vessel systems, and eight ship-state tracks.

assets.title: Tessara One, Manyborn mediator
assets.description: A distributed Manyborn person rendered across a human-scale carrier, a microbial cloud, chemical vessels, and topological light, none of which is presented as the original body.

assets.title: The Rodoh cartridge bay
assets.description: A dark local-first cartridge vault of stone, brass, labeled cases, offline indicators, and a central loading dais.

assets.title: The Rodoh cartridge bay framing
assets.description: Heavy vault jambs, shelf edges, local-status lamps, and a brass footer frame the cartridge bay without obscuring its controls.
